Radish is a mood. It’s all the Romance you can handle. You’re cordially invited to indulge in Radish Fiction, a massively sexy, satisfying and diverse collection of romance audiobooks and novels from top romance story authors, Emmy-winning staff and community writers. For lovers of all things sweet, sultry or downright erotic, there’s a new story or audiobook to read or listen to up to five times per day. When it comes to our latest romance story obsessions, More is More…

ESCAPE INTO ENDLESS EVER-AFTERS

Listen to audiobooks and read stories from all romance sub-genres, across all heat levels.

- Billionaires, bosses and baddies
- Alpha werewolf shifters, fated mates 
- Love triangles, forbidden attraction, age gap relationships
- Enemies-to-Lovers, friends-to-lovers, marriage-of-convenience
- Reverse harem, fantasy auctions, regency romance
- Dark romance, romantic suspense, mafia
- Young adult, new adult, boys love
- And more

AUDIOBOOKS & NOVELS DESIGNED TO EXCITE

No matter who you love or how you love, Radish curates breathtaking romance audiobooks and sexy stories - and they’re waiting to snag you.

- Original serials from our Emmy-winning writers room like The Billionaire’s Surrogate and Torn Between Alphas with daily episode drops - novels and audiobook adaptations
- Full romance audiobooks and novels from names like Julia Quinn, Beverly Jenkins, Jami Gallardo, LJ Shen and Melanie Moreland
- Endless catalog of up-and-coming stories from the writer/readers who define the Radish community - our own app users
- Thrilling erotica stories to suit your mood

DESTINATION ROMANCE

Radish is where listeners, readers and creators converge and communicate, with a shared obsession for emotional, immersive storytelling.

- Leave your comments and chat with like-minded friends at the end of every story chapter or episode
- Jump on opportunities to leave feedback on stories for your favorite authors
- Join in on romance and erotica writer roundtables with Radish Live 
- Keep your favorite stories and audiobooks close by adding them to your Library
- Grab daily deals and rewards in the Radish community Gift Box
